findings.value: A comedy club in Bethnal Green which says it has run as a comedy venue in the East End for two decades. Time Out (2017) described it as run by the comedian Lee Hurst.

evidence.quote: We are the largest professional, purpose built comedy club in London and have been the home of comedy in the East End for the past 20 years.
run by British stand-up Lee Hurst

not_found: status (no closure or new-owner news found; the closing and new-owner searches were not run because the search budget ran out)
notes: The Time Out page is dated 2017-08-28 (last edited 2018), so it only backs the summary's history. The venue's own site lists 'Upcoming Events' and a 2026 copyright line, which suggests it is still operating; the editor should check that against the programme findings. Time Out's page says the club has 'hosted variety shows, cabaret, swing dancing and more' since 2013; that is old and is not proposed as music.
